notes: Staged attachments are Room-backed (schema v6, additive migration 5->6) and keyed by conversation, so chips cannot leak across a conversation switch or a process restart.
Upload intent is a distinct phase from uploaded. UPLOADED is reachable only from an authoritative attachment.ready event. The binary upload contract was not invented.
Failed uploads expose a deterministic retry that re-declares the same opaque id, and a remove that deletes the private file and its thumbnail.
Thumbnail decode is LRU-capped at 16 entries, edge-clamped to 512, persisted under thumbs/, and dropped on attachment delete. Opaque-id check rejects path-like ids.
EXIF/GPS stripping by JPEG re-encode is unchanged.
